title: owo-lib release [26.1+] oωo - 0.13.1
text:
## Fixes
- The game no longer crashes when running with REI, and the REI integration of the library mostly works again
- Resolve [crash](https://github.com/wisp-forest/owo-lib/issues/480) with translation arg unpacker passing a null value instead of empty array

## Additions
- `BaseOwoContainerScreen` has gained a secondary constructor which allows specifying the texture width and height, since they're now final
